snippet.title: Sleepover| Announcement Trailer and Steam Page Reveal
snippet.description:
Wishlist it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4549500
"Sleepover is a cosmic horror visual-novel about the last two humans alive. After the entire population of Earth mysteriously vanishes, the sole survivor, Yuna, struggles to find meaning in an empty world. After a mysterious girl appears at her front door, the two begin their final night together. "
